sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.322 - Dev

  • Edit form type selector cleaned up. The Color/Fixed/Fluid/Static row is now a clean labels-only segmented control (the small icons rendered washed-out).
  • Color swatch matches the value field height. The swatch was a fixed 42px while the value field is 38px; it now uses the control height so the box and input line up.

v1.3.321 - Dev

  • Variable edit form redesigned (approved mock). The flat stack is now four clear sections — Type (a connected Color/Fixed/Fluid/Static segmented control), Identity (name with a live --css-name preview, plus category), Value (the per-type editor), and Impact (a card that only appears on rename — green “safe” when unused, amber otherwise, with the update-usages toggle and Preview impact). Same fields and behavior, grouped and legible, with a proper Cancel / Save changes footer.

v1.3.320 - Dev

  • Bar shortcut now keeps focus when opened from a code editor. The editor (Code2Bricks) was refocusing its own textarea the instant it lost focus, so plain re-focus ping-ponged back. MV now briefly disables the editor field so it can't reclaim focus, moves the caret into the Bar, then restores the field.
  • Class-chip badges have hover feedback. Hovering the duplicate or remove badge now pops it (slight scale + brighten + glow) so they read as interactive.

v1.3.319 - Dev

  • Duplicate-class icon is now a corner badge, matching the remove ×. It floats on the pill's top-right corner just left of the × (same 20×20 size, shape, and hover scale-reveal) instead of sitting inline inside the pill.
  • Bar shortcut focus, harder try. When opened from a code editor, MV blurs the editor field and pulls focus back to the Bar input across a short window (30/90/180/320 ms) to beat editors that reclaim focus after open.

v1.3.318 - Dev

  • New/duplicated classes now show their real name immediately in the Bar, not a raw id like .hkszmp. The id→name map was cached for 650ms, so a just-created class rendered as its id until the cache expired and you reopened. Creating or duplicating a class now invalidates that cache. (Item 6.)
  • Copy icon reveals on hover, exactly like the remove × — opacity-only (keeps its slot, so the pill never resizes under the cursor), right next to the ×.
  • Bar shortcut reliably moves focus off the code editor — it blurs the editor field and re-focuses the Bar input after open, so opening from Code2Bricks lands the caret in the Bar.

v1.3.317 - Dev

  • Bar shortcut now moves focus into the command field when opened from a code editor (the caret used to stay in the Code2Bricks textarea).
  • Fixed the duplicate-class icon flickering on hover. It revealed itself by animating width, which resized the pill under the cursor and caused a hover-flicker loop. It's now always visible next to the remove ×, styled the same (dim, brightens on hover) — no reveal animation.

v1.3.316 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar: duplicate a class with its styles. Hovering an existing-class chip now reveals a duplicate icon next to the remove ×. Clicking it clones the global class — a new {name}-copy whose styles are a deep copy of the original — and applies it to the current element, so its chip appears ready to rename/edit.

v1.3.315 - Dev

  • Bulk “review selected” bar cleaned up (approved mock). Cancel and Delete are now compact icon buttons (× and trash) separated from the primary Move-to / Move / Family group by a divider, so the destructive Delete reads as clearly distinct instead of a flat cluster of text buttons.

v1.3.314 - Dev

  • Figma connection screen redesigned (approved mock). Opens with a clear connection-status header (● Not connected / Connected), then two numbered steps: 1) generate credentials with the pairing code and API key each in their own copyable field (one-click copy), or 2) enter a code shown in the Figma plugin. Same actions, clearer flow.

v1.3.313 - Dev

  • Export formats are now a clear list, not ambiguous tabs. The old export row looked like selectable tabs, so it wasn't obvious a click downloads. Each format is now a row with an icon, a one-line description, and an explicit Download button — System Bundle featured as the complete/primary format, with DTCG, Flat, Figma, and CSS as interoperability exports. First of the approved review-pass redesigns.

v1.3.312 - Dev

  • Mimam's Bar shortcut now opens from inside code editors. When focus was in a text field — notably the Code2Bricks editor textarea — the Bar's open shortcut was ignored, so you had to click a canvas element first. A shortcut using a modifier (Ctrl/Cmd/Alt) now fires even from within an input/textarea (a plain-key shortcut still won't hijack typing).
  • Selected media tiles now show their checkmark. The checked checkbox on media thumbnails resolved to background-image: none, so selected items were just a solid lime square. The checkmark is now forced on the media selection state.

v1.3.311 - Dev

  • Variable changes now reflect on the site without a manual refresh. The server already regenerated variables.css on every create/edit/delete, but the <link> already loaded in the admin page and the Bricks canvas iframe still pointed at the stale file — so deleting a used variable (and other edits) only showed after reloading. MV now cache-busts the generated CSS links across the admin document and the canvas iframe whenever the variable set actually changes. Signature-gated so the background 30-second/focus refresh doesn’t re-fetch needlessly.

v1.3.310 - Dev

  • Content Studio list no longer gets stuck on “Loading…”. Re-selecting the already-active content type (e.g. clicking Pages again after an import) showed the spinner but never re-fired the load effect, because the active nav hadn’t changed — so it spun forever with “0 items” until you reopened the studio. Same-nav reselection now loads directly.

v1.3.309 - Dev

  • New setting: “Media Studio as Bricks media picker” (Settings → Studio defaults). MV replaces the Bricks builder’s media control with Media Studio; this toggle (default on) lets you turn that off so media controls open the native WordPress media library instead. The interception now checks the preference before taking over the wp.media frame.

v1.3.308 - Dev

  • The “Delete variable?” impact dialog no longer traps you. With many affected consumers the box grew past the screen, pushing the Keep/Delete buttons off-screen with no way to scroll or dismiss (only a full refresh escaped it). It’s now a fixed-height flex column capped at 86vh — header and actions stay visible, the consumer list scrolls inside, and clicking the backdrop closes it.

v1.3.307 - Dev

  • Media Studio remembers the last collection you were in. Reopening it (from Bricks or anywhere) returns to that collection instead of resetting to All media; a since-deleted collection falls back to All rather than opening empty.
  • Imported media titles no longer turn spaces into 20. A URL space is %20, and sanitize_file_name() stripped the % but kept the 20 (so lagos image became lagos20image). Percent-encoding is now decoded before sanitizing.

v1.3.306 - Dev

  • Unitless variables (font-weight, line-height, z-index, opacity, …) are no longer converted to rem on import. The dimension normalizer applied the project's 10px-rem conversion to the whole font namespace, so a Figma font-weight: 100 came through as 1rem instead of 100. Normalization now gates on the token family, not the namespace: weight/line-height/z-index/opacity/order/flex pass through untouched, while real length tokens (font-size, space, radius) still convert.
  • New content defaults its author to the logged-in user instead of the first author in the site list, when creating a page/post or opening the content importer (you can still change it).

v1.3.305 - Dev

  • Studio defaults synchronize before paint. Content Studio and Media Studio re-read the configured Normal or Full screen default on both close and open in the pre-paint layout phase, so changing the default while a Studio is hidden cannot reintroduce a stale-view flash.

v1.3.304 - Dev

  • Studio defaults now apply before reopen. Closing Content Studio or Media Studio while Full screen can no longer flash stale fullscreen geometry when a Normal default is configured, and the inverse Full screen default path is equally preloaded.
  • All module color pickers return to one approved visual core. Variable, Content highlight, and Media collection contexts now share the same compact dark map, tracks, channel fields, and format tabs. Media removes its unrelated preset grid while keeping Clear and Apply.

v1.3.303 - Dev

  • Studio fullscreen now stays at the viewport origin. The final shared open-panel rule can no longer reapply a centering transform after Content Studio or Media Studio becomes viewport-sized, eliminating the top-left-quarter result.

v1.3.302 - Dev

  • Color-picker keyboard cancellation is now lossless. Escape restores the original draft without the following blur event recommitting the cancelled value. This package also contains the v1.3.301 Studio fullscreen, fresh-site listing, Import cleanup, and shared picker fixes.

v1.3.301 - Dev

  • Studio fullscreen and fresh-site content loading are repaired. Full screen now owns the complete viewport geometry, and plain-permalink REST roots keep endpoint filters outside rest_route, so Pages/Posts load on fresh sites and after Import/View imported content.
  • Import and shared color controls are cleaner. The obsolete first-release explainer is removed; HEX/channel text commits on blur or Enter and restores on Escape; the color map supports pointer dragging.

v1.3.300 - Dev

  • Content and Media Studio can now open full screen. A Phosphor expand/contract action sits directly beside Close, while Settings → General adds synced defaults for Content Studio theme, Content Studio view, and Media Studio view. Defaults apply on open; temporary header/theme changes remain temporary.
  • Import test coverage is easier and safer. Reusable CSV/TSV fixtures cover automatic mapping, quoted and multiline content, custom columns, media, missing titles, and duplicates. Review now skips duplicate slugs inside one source file before Apply.

v1.3.299 - Dev

  • Content Studio now has a safe structured-content import workspace. CSV/TSV files move through Upload, Map, Review, and Import with quote-aware parsing, automatic/editable mapping, post type/status/author defaults, duplicate/update choices, visible invalid and skipped rows, exact confirmation, protected remote featured-image imports, and retained result reports. Server review performs no writes and apply recomputes the plan before changing WordPress.
  • Theme-state polish: the approved theme capsule keeps its geometry and lime active segment while its neutral shell follows Light/Dark, and the dark editor topbar now gives the article title the same quiet hierarchy as Light mode.

v1.3.298 - Dev

  • Content Studio light and Preview presentation are calmer and consistent. The update progress and banner now use readable neutral light surfaces; the approved dark-capsule Light/Dark selector lives in the shared action row in both editor and Preview; Preview removes the edit label, title-card framing, and black content stroke; the light topbar title is quieter; and Content status filters keep their individual pills without an outer family container.

v1.3.297 - Dev

  • Content Studio live-review polish is complete. Light mode now carries into portaled author and taxonomy menus plus Structure toolbar states; the Light/Dark control matches the approved dark capsule with a lime active segment; Preview keeps Back to editor and Desktop/Tablet/Mobile together on one row; and Content now matches the other editor buttons without the notice color showing through its corners. The confirmed-working table icon and shared Content-list appearance are preserved.

v1.3.296 - Dev

  • Content Studio canvas theming now belongs to the editor. Light/Dark switches the outline, toolbar, writing canvas, preview, author and taxonomy controls, and right rail together, while returning to the Content list leaves the shared MV appearance untouched. The control matches the approved neutral segmented design, light-mode contrast and clipping are corrected, Preview keeps Back to editor in its action row with Desktop/Tablet/Mobile directly beneath it, and the column chooser once again uses the bundled duotone table icon.

v1.3.295 - Dev

  • Content Studio preview is now a clean, bounded reading surface. The top Preview action becomes Back to editor while previewing; Focus, save state, and Update are hidden; the duplicate Exit preview and View-only labels are removed; and the responsive device row contains only Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile. Long posts now scroll to their final block because the canvas owns vertical scrolling instead of competing with nested 100% height rules. The content-list column chooser also uses the supported table icon.

v1.3.294 - Dev

  • Content Studio now has a proper light/dark mode for the whole studio, not just the editor text. The canvas toggle used to recolor only the writing surface, leaving the structure panel, toolbar, Publish/SEO/Block rail, and window header dark — so “light” looked half-broken. The theme is now lifted to the studio root and mirrored onto the panel frame, so one toggle themes the title bar, the structure outline, the editor toolbar and paper, and the whole right rail together. The lime brand is kept for buttons, active pills, and fills; where lime would be text or an icon on a light surface it steps down to a readable dark‑olive (#557a00) so nothing is illegible. Dark mode is unchanged. The canvas control is now a segmented Light / Dark toggle (sun/moon) instead of a single icon, and your choice persists.

v1.3.293 - Dev

  • Recovery no longer shows a “session expired” 403 or a frozen/“skipped” step after a guarded restore's database swap — the admin now refreshes itself cleanly. The restore's job status lives in a database table, so the instant the destructive “Swap DB Tables” step replaces the live database with the backup's, the in-flight job row briefly vanishes (403 / “job not found”) until RestoreBase re-seeds it. The status poller gave up after only 4 failed polls during that blackout, so it never observed the final “completed” status — the very thing that triggers the automatic admin refresh — and the last step stayed painted as unfinished. The poller is now swap-aware: once it sees the restore enter the destructive swap zone it keeps polling through the expected blackout, reaches “completed”, and fires the clean auto-refresh (forced reload as a fallback if the row re-seeds slowly). Any nonce request that still races the swap now shows a calm “reconnecting after database swap” notice instead of the alarming 403. No restore/swap logic changed — this is entirely in the panel's polling and messaging.

v1.3.292 - Dev

  • Recovery can now run a guarded restore on a live/production site, not just staging. The production path was blocking itself — after the typed “RESTORE PRODUCTION” confirmation, readiness still counted “this is production” as two danger checks, dropping the score below the 65 gate. Readiness/dry-run are now production-aware: a confirmed production restore treats the live site as the intended target, while every real safeguard stays (typed confirmation, package validation, disk check, danger-preview/WooCommerce checks, pre-restore rollback snapshot). The staging ladder keeps its strict behavior.

v1.3.291 - Dev

  • Recovery readiness is now truthful: The dynamically loaded Recovery runtime declares readiness only after its complete setup succeeds; partial initialization reports an error instead of leaving an active rail icon with no panel.
  • Direct Studio rail handoff: The shared rail now calls Recovery's own open/close bridge and verifies the resulting state, while preserving the event route as a compatibility fallback.

v1.3.290 - Dev

  • Recovery enables without a reload: Turning Recovery on for Admin now installs its panel markup, runtime configuration, styles, script, and handlers into the current page, so its Studio rail action works immediately.
  • Idempotent runtime: Repeated enable cycles cannot duplicate the Recovery panel or bind its event handlers twice.

v1.3.288 - Dev

  • Fixed MV darkening other plugins’ code editors in the Bricks builder. MV loaded CodeMirror’s stylesheet globally and neutralized .CodeMirror to a transparent background page-wide, making Advanced Themer’s Style Manager CSS editor (and any other CodeMirror) go dark instead of keeping its own background. MV’s CodeMirror CSS is now pre-scoped to its own .ve-cm-host editors and the global neutralization is removed, so foreign editors are untouched — AT’s editor keeps its light background whether MV is on or off.

v1.3.287 - Dev

  • Snapshot Restore/Delete are now compact icon buttons (a counter-clockwise arrow and a trash icon, side by side) instead of stacked text buttons, so the Snapshots list reads cleaner. Hover/disabled states and tooltips retained.

v1.3.286 - Dev

  • Snapshots are now manageable. Each snapshot has a Delete button (with confirm), the list auto-prunes to the 20 most recent so recovery points can't grow unbounded, and creating a snapshot with a state identical to the newest one reuses it instead of stacking a duplicate (collapsing back-to-back "Before import" points).
  • The migration Preview button now reads "Re-preview" once a preview exists, making clear it refreshes the scan rather than starting over.

v1.3.285 - Dev

  • Fixed a whole scale family being skipped when its base collides on CSS name with an existing wrapper-namespaced variable. An imported space family (→ --space) was unified with an existing size.space (also --space), so the import renamed the base space → size.space but left the children pointing at the old space — skipping all 15 space-* steps + aliases (22 items) as "source 'space' not found". The rename now propagates to every child/alias source, so the family imports cleanly. Reproduced the exact 22-skip against real data and confirmed 0 after.

v1.3.284 - Dev

  • Variable migration now imports base scale steps whose value is a long fluid clamp() formula. The scanner's value check rejected anything over 220 characters, but Advanced Themer's fluid clamp() values run ~400–450 chars — so font-size-s, radius-s, and the whole space-* scale were silently dropped, orphaning every alias that pointed at them (font-size-caption, radius-default, section-content-title, space-grid-gap, …). The cap is raised to 2000 chars, so those steps import and the aliases resolve. Reproduced the exact skip list at 220 and confirmed 0 skips at 2000 against the real registry.

v1.3.283 - Dev

  • Variable migration no longer lists Core Framework as a source when its plugin is uninstalled. Removing Core Framework leaves its options and the core_framework_presets table behind, which made MV keep showing it as an available source (a "ghost") and scan its orphaned tokens. The scanner now gates on the plugin being active, so a removed framework stops appearing and its leftovers are ignored (those tokens are read from Bricks/Advanced Themer instead). No data is deleted.

v1.3.282 - Dev

  • Imported color shades now sort sensibly inside each color family: all light steps first (-l-1…8), then dark (-d-1…8), then transparent (-t-1…8), instead of interleaving by step number. Matches the Color Manager. Display-only — no re-migration needed; spacing/size families are unaffected.

v1.3.281 - Dev

  • Color migration now also brings across each color's shade children (the -l-1…8, -d-1…8, -t-1…8 light/dark/transparent steps), not just the base colors. They import with their own stored values and nest as generated children under each base color, mirroring the Advanced Themer Color Manager.

v1.3.280 - Dev

  • Variable migration now imports the full Advanced Themer color palette (all 14 base colors), not just the 6 theme-level ones. The complete palette lives in bricks_color_palette, where the base colors sit alongside 252 auto-generated shades. The scanner now reads both palette options and skips isShade entries, so the semantic colors (color-bg-body, color-text-body, color-border-primary, color-shadow-primary, etc.) migrate in with their real values while the regenerable shades are excluded. Verified against the real 266-entry palette export.

v1.3.279 - Dev

  • Variable migration now imports the Advanced Themer / Bricks color palette. AT's Color Manager stores its palette in the bricks_theme_styles option, not in bricks_global_variables, so migration previously imported zero colors even with a full palette. MV now reads that option — taking each color's name from its raw var(--color-*) and its value from rawValue.light — so your base palette (primary, neutral-light/dark, success, warning, error) migrates in as color variables. Verified against a real exported palette.

v1.3.278 - Dev

  • Fixed the styled tooltip still rendering ~350px wide in the Bricks builder. After v1.3.277 removed the native title, the remaining wide bubble was the styled card: a live console read showed width:350px while its own max-width was 220px — only possible when an external min-width (from Bricks/Advanced Themer) overrides it. MV now forces min-width:0 on the tooltip card, so compact tooltips hug their text in the builder exactly as in wp-admin.

v1.3.277 - Dev

  • Actually fixed the raw, over-wide browser tooltip in the Bricks builder. Rather than racing the browser on hover, MV now strips the native title off every panel surface the moment it paints and mirrors it into the styled tooltip's own attribute — so the browser has nothing to show natively, and the fix works regardless of which frame the builder mounts the panel in.

v1.3.276 - Dev

  • Fixed raw over-wide browser tooltips in the Bricks builder. The styled-tooltip handler now matches any MV surface, so builder tooltips render styled like in wp-admin instead of falling back to the browser title.

v1.3.275 - Dev

  • Variable families can be collapsed under a source filter again — they were being force-expanded when a source (AT/CF/etc.) was selected, so the toggle did nothing.
  • Long tooltips now wrap instead of forming an over-wide, truncated bar; short ones still hug their text.

v1.3.274 - Dev

  • Variable migration no longer aborts on a generated variable with a missing source. Generated variables are now transitively skipped like aliases, so the rest of the migration applies.
  • Preact and CodeMirror are bundled with the plugin instead of loaded from a CDN — the builder now works offline, under strict CSP, and on privacy-strict hosts. Unused GSAP removed.
  • Compact tooltips no longer render too wide in the Bricks builder.

v1.3.273 - Dev

  • Security (completes v1.3.272): the credentialed-CORS fix now also covers the REST response handler, not just the preflight. Both paths gate Allow-Credentials to first-party origins only.

v1.3.272 - Dev

  • Security: CORS no longer allows credentialed cross-origin access. The API stopped reflecting an arbitrary Origin alongside Allow-Credentials; cookie-authenticated access is limited to the site’s own origin, and the Figma plugin (API-key auth) is unaffected.
  • Security: pairing codes are brute-force resistant. Wrong guesses burn the code after eight tries, attempts are throttled per IP, and the comparison is timing-safe.

v1.3.271 - Dev

  • Variable migration no longer fails wholesale on one unresolvable alias. A single alias whose source cannot be found at apply time is now skipped with a named warning — like the preview already does — and every other reviewed change applies and verifies normally.
  • Compact tooltips hug their text instead of rendering as too-wide bubbles.

v1.3.270 - Dev

  • Migrate Variables preview no longer collapses into a thin bar. The preview list kept getting flex-shrunk to zero height when the panel overflowed; it now holds its own height and the panel scrolls.
  • Tooltips keep their caret. Wide compact tooltips were clipping the caret off via the bubble’s own overflow; the text ellipsis now clips an inner element instead.

v1.3.269 - Dev

  • Optimized tooltips. Hover labels (like "Sync", "Refresh", "New variable") now auto-size dynamically, removing excessive empty space and keeping tooltip cards compact.
  • Fixed Migrate Variables wizard clipping. Corrected the sub-panel body flex style so the Migrate Variables preview card and form fields scroll cleanly without being clipped or pushed under the bottom of the screen.

v1.3.268 - Dev

  • Reactive module toggling. Gated panels in the builder UI now respond immediately to module activation changes without requiring a page refresh.
  • User settings persistence. Deactivated modules are synchronized to user metadata, avoiding conflicts between user preference states.
  • Fixed variable migration preview. Corrected layout containers inside the migration wizard, keeping preview items and fields fully scrollable above the actions bar.
  • Polished compact tooltip. Caret styling on compact tooltips aligns perfectly to the card borders.

v1.3.267 - Dev

  • No more false "Pretty URLs are not active" warning. The server self-probe false-negatives on local sites; your browser now re-verifies it directly and the row only warns — with instructions — when the browser cannot reach /wp-json either. A blocked self-probe no longer downgrades a clean restore to "passed with notes".

v1.3.266 - Dev

  • No more manual Permalinks save after a restore. The rewrite-rule repair re-initializes the rewrite engine from the restored settings and writes the rules directly, closing the two silent no-ops that kept requiring the manual save. If the server still refuses, the post-restore report now says exactly what to do in its own verification row.
  • "View restore steps" shows status dots with text in every report container, matching the job-card design.

v1.3.265 - Dev

  • Restored sites no longer look broken when the server lacks rewrite rules. A restored database brings pretty permalinks, but the protected .htaccess on a fresh destination has no WordPress rules, so /wp-json 404ed at Apache and every Studio errored against a perfectly restored site. MV now falls back to the ?rest_route= form automatically, and post-restore hardening writes the rewrite rules and verifies /wp-json answers.

v1.3.264 - Dev

  • Closed the last silent truncation point. A partial workspace extraction could leave a short file bundle that restored "green" while missing its tail files. The workspace is now verified against the package checksums before anything destructive runs, and the file-restore step fails with exact counts ("read X of Y") if the bundle ends early.
  • "View restore steps" matches the job-card design — status dot and text instead of filled pills.

v1.3.263 - Dev

  • Truncated backups are now caught at import. The number of files actually inside the bundle is compared against the count recorded at backup time; a short package is rejected with the exact counts instead of restoring half a site.
  • Footer status dot stays with its message.

v1.3.262 - Dev

  • Backups can no longer silently ship only the first ~20,000 files. A failed inventory re-read mid-backup used to finalize a truncated bundle that passed every checksum and restored half a site. The bundler now stops loudly instead of producing an incomplete package. Make a new backup on this version.
  • No more "Database Update Required" after a restore. The silent WordPress database upgrade now runs automatically when the restored database needs it.
  • Nicer details. Backup ages show hours and minutes ("1h 22m ago"), and the Recovery footer status text has proper spacing.

v1.3.261 - Dev

  • A settings check can no longer abort a restore. The MV settings step runs after the database swap but before files are copied, so failing it left a half-restored site — files never copied, Studios reading no content. The restore now always completes; a settings read-back mismatch is reported as a note that names the affected groups.

v1.3.260 - Dev

  • Recovery carries current MV settings honestly. New backups capture the current Core, Modules, Mimam's Bar, and Studio preferences; restore clears WordPress option/user caches, verifies the applied groups, and fails visibly instead of reporting a false success.
  • Studios recover after a database restore. The post-restore runtime refreshes the destination user and roles, and shared Studio requests renew an expired REST nonce once instead of turning authorization errors into empty Content or Media libraries.
  • Restored Studio preferences remain authoritative. Browser-held Media settings no longer overwrite the server-restored preferences when Studios reopen.
  • Important: Create a new backup with v1.3.260 so it contains the expanded MV preference groups.

v1.3.259 - Dev

  • Staging-only restores map prefixes and preserve login. Enabled safety prefix mapping and destination administrator login preservation on staging restores, matching production restore security.
  • Studios capability authorization repair. Resolved the issue where Content Studio, Media Studio, and other rails showed 0 items after a staging database restore by mapping old prefixes (e.g. wp_) to the new destination prefix for options and user metadata.
  • Immediate cache invalidation after DB swap. Flushed the WordPress options and user caches immediately after database table swaps to prevent stale pre-restore cache values from causing incorrect settings merges.

v1.3.258 - Dev

  • Guarded workflow auto-run checks. Added a new "Auto-run checks" button that executes validation, impact preview, dry-run, and workspace preparation sequentially in a single click.
  • Database prefix mapping. Fixed a critical issue where Content Studio, Media Studio, and other rails showed 0 items after a database restore when the backup prefix differed from the destination prefix. The restore engine now maps database table prefixes in options (specifically `{prefix}user_roles`) and usermeta columns automatically during the post-restore hardening phase.
  • Checklist UI spacing. Adjusted the padding and margins on the safety checklist items (.rb-risk) to give the status dots and text cleaner spacing.

v1.3.257 - Dev

  • Restore no longer fails at the final MV settings step. After the database swap, the settings verification was reading stale cached values and wrongly reporting the just-written settings as unverifiable. The cache is now cleared correctly, and MV settings can no longer fail a restore whose database and files already restored — a verification miss is just a note.

v1.3.256 - Dev

  • Backup import rejection fixed for good. The backup job is now serialized with a database lock so overlapping requests cannot finalize the bundle twice, and package checksums are recomputed from disk in the same step that zips them — so a package can never be a few bytes out of step with its own checksum, even on hosts that ignore file locks. Make a new backup on this version; older backups must be re-created.

v1.3.255 - Dev

  • Fixed backup import rejection at the root. Overlapping job requests could finalize the file bundle more than once, making it larger than its recorded checksum. Finalization is now atomic (exclusive file lock), so backups made on this version import and restore correctly.
  • Fixed wrong backup timestamps. Ages like “1h ago” on a just-made backup (when the site timezone differs from the viewer) now use the site’s UTC offset.

v1.3.254 - Dev

  • Fixed backups rejected on import as “incomplete or corrupted.” A file-bundle end marker could be written twice under concurrent job polling, making the packaged bundle a few bytes larger than its recorded checksum. Finalization is now idempotent. Make a new backup on this version; backups built by earlier versions must be re-created.

v1.3.253 - Dev

  • Backup filenames use the plugin version. Downloads now read v1.3.253 instead of the Recovery module’s internal v1.0.0-rc version.
  • Clearer import errors. A rejected package now says whether a part is the wrong size or fails its checksum, instead of a generic message.

v1.3.252 - Dev

  • CSS Recipes joins the Studio rail. CSS Recipes now carries the shared Studio rail, stays reachable while other Studios are open, and is no longer closed when CSS Studio is disabled.
  • Icons no longer depend on a CDN. The Phosphor duotone set ships inside the plugin, so icons render on sites that cannot reach a third-party CDN.
  • Media Studio icons are correct. Save metadata, Import, Restore, Insert Media URL, safety notes, and the collection icon picker no longer fall back to a generic file glyph.
  • Image replacement carries alt text. Replacing a content image now brings the new attachment’s alt text with it instead of keeping the previous one.
  • Dynamic tooltips stay current. The canvas theme control updates its icon and tooltip immediately, including while the pointer stays on the button.
  • Recovery explains a pending reload. Re-enabling Recovery after the page has loaded now says a reload is needed instead of appearing to do nothing.
